basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old music enthusiast and anime fan based in Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to pursue my passions. I spend my evenings diving into philosophical debates and exploring the complexities of human relationships on subreddits like PurplePillDebate. While I’m not a fan of rigid social scripts, I enjoy discussing them. I’m single and enjoy attending music festivals, particularly those with electronic and indie music scenes. I’m usually online during late evenings, especially post-midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from a local university. My knowledge of societal norms and relationship dynamics is largely self-taught, gathered from hours of reading Reddit threads and online articles. I also have a keen interest in psychology, which I explore through various subreddits.
